title: 海上風機發電機整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

stages.title: 能量與傳動
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成能量與傳動；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete energy and drivetrain through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識能量邊界：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Define energy boundaries: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識能量邊界，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand define energy boundaries through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識能量邊界」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If define energy boundaries disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識能量邊界」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for define energy boundaries, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：15 MW、10 rpm 時，ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s，軸轉矩 T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m；若機電效率 96%，15 MW 軸輸入只得 14.4 MW 電輸出。這是量綱練習，不是參考風機額定規格。 穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: at 15 MW and 10 rpm, ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s and shaft torque T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m. With 96% electromechanical efficiency, 15 MW shaft input yields 14.4 MW electrical output. This is a dimensional exercise, not a reference-turbine rating. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

steps.check: 交付「分辨參考風機與產品」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate reference models from products, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：15 MW、10 rpm 時，ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s，軸轉矩 T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m；若機電效率 96%，15 MW 軸輸入只得 14.4 MW 電輸出。這是量綱練習，不是參考風機額定規格。 穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: at 15 MW and 10 rpm, ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s and shaft torque T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m. With 96% electromechanical efficiency, 15 MW shaft input yields 14.4 MW electrical output. This is a dimensional exercise, not a reference-turbine rating. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.

steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「公開參考風機用於可重現研究，不等於商用製造圖。」的觀察。把參考模型的轉速、控制器與柔性假設列成表，標記不可直接移植的輸入。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: An open reference turbine enables reproducible research, not commercial fabrication. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 把參考模型的轉速、控制器與柔性假設列成表，標記不可直接移植的輸入。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Tabulate speed, controller and flexibility assumptions and flag inputs that cannot transfer directly. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分辨參考風機與產品」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
